I'm **Ba-Hien Tran**.

**nano-agents** is my study notebook on agentic AI, written publicly. The goal is to internalize the field through the lens I find clearest — probabilistic modeling and Bayesian inference — and to share the derivations and code that emerge along the way.

Each post derives one piece of the modern stack from first principles, implements it in a few hundred lines of NumPy or PyTorch, and ships with experiments that build intuition. The companion notebooks let you run and tweak everything.

If something here is wrong, unclear, or could be sharper, please [open an issue](https://github.com/tranbahien/nano-agents/issues).
